description: Method to change the ownership of folders and optionally dashboards.

folder_name.description: The target folder whose ownership needs to be changed.

new_owner_name.description: The new owner to whom the folder (and optionally dashboards) ownership will be transferred.

original_owner_rule.description: Specifies the ownership rule to set original owner after changing ownership('edit' or 'view'). Default is 'edit'.

change_dashboard_ownership.description: Specifies whether to also change the ownership of dashboards in the folder tree. Default is True.

examples.user_query: How can I transfer ownership of the 'Sales Reports' folder to the user 'john.doe' and ensure all dashboards in the folder are also transferred?
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'Sales Reports' folder and all associated dashboards to 'john.doe'. The original owner will retain 'edit' permissions.

examples.user_query: I need to change the owner of the 'Marketing Data' folder to 'jane.smith' but keep the dashboards under the original owner.
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'Marketing Data' folder to 'jane.smith' while leaving the dashboards under the original owner's control with 'view' permissions.

examples.user_query: Can I reassign the 'Finance Reports' folder to 'alex.jones' and also transfer all dashboards, while ensuring the original owner retains 'view' access?
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'Finance Reports' folder and all associated dashboards to 'alex.jones'. The original owner will retain 'view' permissions.
